name: Fish & seafood infant dinners
development_note: SCAFFOLD — NOT certification-ready; do not publish as a standard. Purpose: give the Cat-1 mixed-meals fish-exclusion a routing destination. Fish's DEFINING hazards are methylmercury (MeHg) and inorganic/total arsenic (iAs/tAs), and neither is finished here: (1) the Cat-1 compiler panel (DEFAULT_PANEL / config.panel) does not include MeHg or tAs, so those cells are not emitted at all — the remaining work is to extend the panel for this subcategory; (2) the governing fish mercury ceiling must be derived by read-across to the Cat-6 seafood MeHg standard scaled by the dish's fish fraction — a methodology decision, not a register lookup. The 8-panel cells below resolve via DISCLOSED read-across to the nearest infant-food government values, but the total-mercury cell in particular is a baby-food PLACEHOLDER, not the fish-appropriate mercury control, and the iAs cell (China aquatic complementary 300) is a provisional aquatic-infant-food value that EU 2025/1891 fish-muscle iAs 100 may supersede once the fish-fraction basis is fixed. Remaining derivation: (a) extend the panel with MeHg + tAs for this subcategory; (b) derive the MeHg ceiling via Cat-6 read-across x fish-fraction; (c) re-derive iAs/tHg on a fish basis. Until COMPLETE + REGISTERED + CORRECTED this stays a scaffold.

Pb.label: read-across — US FDA processed-baby-food Pb action level 10 (the strictest infant-food Pb value). FDA's enumerated scope does not itemise fish dinners, so 10 is applied here as a disclosed read-across, not direct governance.
Pb.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

iAs.label: PROVISIONAL read-across — China GB 2762 canned complementary infant foods made from aquatic products / animal liver, iAs 300 (the nearest government iAs value for an aquatic infant complementary food). NOT final: EU 2025/1891 fish-muscle iAs 100 is a stricter fish-specific alternative; the finished fish iAs cell needs the fish-fraction derivation (see development_note).
iAs.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

tHg.label: PLACEHOLDER read-across — China GB 2762 canned complementary infant foods total-Hg 20. This is a baby-food placeholder, NOT the fish-appropriate mercury control: fish concentrates methylmercury, and the governing ceiling must be derived from the Cat-6 seafood MeHg standard x fish fraction (in development). Do not treat this cell as final.
tHg.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Cd.label: read-across — EU 2023/915 baby-food / processed-cereal-based-food Cd 40 (the strictest infant-food Cd), applied to a fish-containing infant food as a disclosed read-across.
Cd.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Cr.control: Non-dairy fish matrix: no government sets a total-Cr ML; reflex Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr > 100 ug/kg, any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS; reflex Cr(VI) by EPA 3060A alkaline digestion + IC-ICP-MS (or EN 15192) on any total-Cr > 100 ug/kg.

Ni.label: read-across — EU 2024/1987 baby-food (except juices) Ni 500, applied to a fish-containing infant food as a disclosed read-across.
Ni.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Sn.label: government read-across (India FSSAI "Infant Milk substitute and Infant foods" Sn 5000, the only non-canned tin ML in the register) applied at face value.
Sn.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Al.label: government read-across (AU-NZ Schedule 19 infant-formula Al 500, the only government aluminium ML in any jurisdiction) applied at face value; the 8:1 reconstitution factor is formula-specific and is not applied to a non-formula product.
Al.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default, 8:1 basis, read-across)
